verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Snyk CLI is explicitly designed to run in CI/CD pipelines (snyk-gh-3, snyk-gh-7) and that `snyk test`/`snyk code test` reports vulnerabilities found (snyk-gh-4, snyk-gh-6), which is the standard mechanism CI systems use to gate builds. However, the pack has no explicit documentation of PR-trigger configuration or exit-code semantics for failing builds, and the probe shows the CLI requires authentication for every scan (snyk-probe-5), adding an operational caveat for CI setup. Missing for 10: explicit docs on PR-triggered CI workflows, documented exit-code behavior (e.g., non-zero on new findings), and any GitHub Actions/PR-check integration guide.
